chunks: Never think that those who are killed in the way of God are dead. They are alive, getting succour from their Lord,

key_terms.عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ: in the presence of their Lord

ai.seo_question: Are martyrs truly dead or alive according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the martyrdom of Imam al-Husayn (AS), illustrating that physical death is merely a transition to a higher plane of existence where the soul enjoys immediate divine sustenance (ruziqun). It underscores the concept of 'Barzakh' as a realm of active life rather than mere waiting, affirming the spiritual vitality of the righteous who die in God's cause.
